Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or Tamers or my opponent's Digimon or Tamers?
Can this card's [When Digivolving] effect give "can't unsuspend" to a card that was not suspended by it?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you trash it.  The standard rules apply even when notes aren't shown.
Card Q&A.q: Does a burst digivolve without notes also trash the top card of the stack at the end of the turn it digivolved, like a normal burst digivolve?

Card Q&A.a: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: Multiple effects trigger when this card digivolves. In what order can they be activated?

DUAL Effect: ＜Use Req. ([DATA SQUAD] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, until their turn ends, none of their suspended Digimon or Tamers can digivolve or unsuspend.
DUAL Rule: ＜Arts Digivolve＞ (Instead of trashing after use, your cards may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
Effect: [When Digivolving] You may suspend 2 Digimon or Tamers. Then, 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By returning 1 other suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck, trash your opponent's top security card.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Burst Digivolve] [Rosemon]: Cost 0 by returning 1 [Yoshino Fujieda] to the hand.
